notes_for_editor: Status gone rests on the FFA California list, which shows Crystal Peak as Gone next to the FFLOS number; the FFLOS detail page gives only an unknown removal date. No source describes what remains today or whether the site is open. The FFA list gives coordinates 39.59928, -120.07070, about 5 km from the FFLOS coordinates used in the record; Wikipedia's peak coordinates (39 33 28 N, 120 05 18 W) agree with FFLOS, so the record is unchanged. The brief's conflict note says the lookouts share a register number; the three US numbers differ, and the state number CA 126 also appears on an NHLR entry, which may be what was meant. The 1938 smoke sighting is not tied to a confirmed fire at the lookout. The 1939 and 1940 road closures are recorded as other events, not closures of the lookout.
